newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia said set to issue mining contracts.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia said set to issue mining contracts.

text.p: Indonesian Mines Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana has forwarded long-delayed mining contracts to President Suharto for final approval, but it was not clear if an application by Bre-X Minerals Ltd of Canada was among them, an industry source said Friday.

Bre-X had applied for contracts to begin exploration at the giant Busang gold find in East Kalimantan, but an ownership dispute with local partner Jusuf Merukh had led the director-general of mines to delay issuing them.
"The contracts of work were sent to Bina Graha (President Suharto's office) two weeks ago and...it usually takes about two weeks for his office to approve COWs," the source told Reuters.
"So, the COWs are likely to be issued anytime now," he said. "But I am not sure if the Bre-X application was among the applications that have been sent to Bina Graha."
